metadata.title: Statistical limits of spiked tensor models
metadata.authors: Amelia Perry, Alexander S. Wein, Afonso S. Bandeira

nodes.name: Wigner tensor
nodes.statement: A Wigner tensor $W \in \mathbb{R}^{n^d}$ of order $d$: an asymmetric precursor $W'$ with \iid $\mathcal{N}(0,2/n)$ entries, symmetrized over index permutations. Distribution density $\propto \exp(-\frac{n}{4}\langle W,W\rangle)$, denoted $\WT(d)$.

nodes.name: Spiked Wigner tensor distribution
nodes.statement: Given prior $\mathcal{X}$ on unit vectors and $\lambda \ge 0$, the spiked distribution $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})$ is the law of $T = \lambda x^{\otimes d} + W$ with $x \sim \mathcal{X}$ and $W \sim \WT(d)$.

nodes.name: Injective norm of a tensor
nodes.statement: For a $d$-tensor $T$, $\|T\| \defeq \max_{\|x\|=1} \langle T, x^{\otimes d}\rangle$.

nodes.name: Spherical prior $\mathcal{X}_{\sph}$
nodes.statement: $x$ is drawn uniformly from the unit sphere in $\mathbb{R}^n$.

nodes.name: Rademacher prior $\mathcal{X}_{\Rade}$
nodes.statement: Each entry of $x$ is drawn \iid from $\{\pm 1/\sqrt{n}\}$.

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher prior $\mathcal{X}_{\spRade}(\rho)$
nodes.statement: A uniformly chosen support of exactly $\rho n$ entries is set to $\pm 1/\sqrt{\rho n}$ \iid; remaining entries are zero.

nodes.name: Strong / weak detection and weak recovery
nodes.statement: Strong detection: distinguish spiked vs unspiked with success $1-o(1)$. Weak detection: success $\frac12+\eps$. Weak recovery: output $\hat x$ with $\mathbb{E}[\langle x,\hat x\rangle^d] \ge \eps$.

nodes.name: $\chi^2$-divergence
nodes.statement: $\chi^2(P\,\|\,Q) = \mathbb{E}_Q[(dP/dQ)^2] - 1$, defined when $P \ll Q$.

nodes.name: Contiguity (Le Cam)
nodes.statement: $P_n \contig Q_n$ if for every event sequence $A_n$ with $Q_n(A_n) \to 0$ we also have $P_n(A_n) \to 0$.

nodes.name: Rate function $f_\mathcal{X}$
nodes.statement: For $x,x'\sim \mathcal{X}_n$ \iid, $f_{n,\mathcal{X}}(t) = -\frac1n\log\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]$. The rate function $f_\mathcal{X}$ is the uniform limit on $[0,1)$ of dominated functions $b_{n,\mathcal{X}} \le f_{n,\mathcal{X}}$.

nodes.name: Locally subgaussian prior
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{X}$ is locally subgaussian with constant $\sigma^2$ if for all $\eta>0$ there is $T>0$ with $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t] \lesssim \exp(-nt^2/(2\sigma^2+\eta))$ for $t\in[0,T]$.

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher rate function $f_\rho$
nodes.statement: $f_\rho(t) = \min_{\zeta\in[\max(\rho t,2\rho-1),\rho]} G(\zeta) + \zeta f_\Rade(\rho t/\zeta)$ with $G(\zeta)=2H(\rho)-H(\{\zeta,\rho-\zeta,\rho-\zeta,1-2\rho+\zeta\})$.

nodes.name: BBP eigenvalue transition for spiked Wigner matrices
nodes.statement: For $T=\lambda xx^\top+W$ Wigner: if $\lambda\le 1$ top eigenvalue $\to 2$ and top eigenvector has trivial overlap with $x$; if $\lambda>1$ top eigenvalue $\to \lambda+1/\lambda$ and $\langle v,x\rangle^2 \to 1-1/\lambda^2$.
conclusions: If $\lambda\le 1$: top eigenvalue $\to 2$ a.s., $\langle v,x\rangle^2 \to 0$ a.s.
If $\lambda>1$: top eigenvalue $\to \lambda+1/\lambda$ a.s., $\langle v,x\rangle^2 \to 1-1/\lambda^2$ a.s.

nodes.name: Injective norm of a Wigner tensor
nodes.statement: For $d\ge 3$, $\|\WT(d)\| = \mu_d + o(1)$ w.p. $1-o(1)$, where $\mu_d = x\sqrt{2/d}$ and $x \ge 2\sqrt{d-1}$ solves $\frac{2-d}{d}-\log(dz^2/2)+\frac{d-1}{2}z^2-\frac{2}{d^2 z^2}=0$ with $z(x)=\frac{1}{(d-1)\sqrt{2d}}(x-\sqrt{x^2-4(d-1)})$.

nodes.name: Spherical prior, large $d$ thresholds
nodes.statement: There exist $\lambda^*_{\sph,d}, \Lambda^*_{\sph,d} = \sqrt{2\log d}+o(1)$ with $\Lambda^*_{\sph,d}<\mu_d$ such that for $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\sph,d}$ weak detection and weak recovery are impossible, and for $\lambda>\Lambda^*_{\sph,d}$ strong detection and weak recovery are possible.
conclusions: If $\lambda>\Lambda^*_{\sph,d}$: strong detection / weak recovery possible

nodes.name: Rademacher prior, large $d$ threshold
nodes.statement: There exists $\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$ with $\lim_{d\to\infty}\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}=2\sqrt{\log 2}$ such that $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$ implies weak detection and weak recovery are impossible, while $\lambda>2\sqrt{\log 2}$ implies strong detection and weak recovery are possible.
conclusions: Lower side: weak detection/recovery impossible for $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$
Upper side: strong detection/weak recovery possible for $\lambda>2\sqrt{\log 2}$

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher prior, large $d$ threshold
nodes.statement: There exists $\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d}$ with $\lim_{d\to\infty}\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d}=2\sqrt{H(\rho)+\rho\log 2}$ such that below this bound detection and recovery are impossible and above $2\sqrt{H(\rho)+\rho\log 2}$ strong detection and weak recovery are possible.
conclusions: If $\lambda > 2\sqrt{H(\rho)+\rho\log 2}$: strong detection / weak recovery possible

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher prior, $\rho \to 0$
nodes.statement: For fixed $d\ge 2$, $\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d} = 2\sqrt{-\rho\log\rho + O(\rho)}$ as $\rho\to 0$. Below: strong detection impossible (and weak detection/recovery if $d\ge 3$). Above $2\sqrt{H(\rho)+\rho\log 2}$: strong detection and weak recovery possible.
conclusions: If $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d}$: strong detection impossible (and weak detection/recovery for $d\ge 3$)
If $\lambda>2\sqrt{H(\rho)+\rho\log 2}$: strong detection / weak recovery possible

nodes.name: Main lower bound theorem (noise conditioning)
nodes.statement: Under hypotheses (i)-(v) (symmetry of $\langle x,x'\rangle$, rate function $f_\mathcal{X}$, $f_\mathcal{X}(t)\ge \frac{(\lambda^*)^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}$, local subgaussianity, and if $d=2$ then $\lambda^*\le 1/\sigma$), for all $\lambda<\lambda^*$: $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})\contig \WT(d)$, and for $d\ge 3$ TV-distance is $o(1)$ and weak recovery is impossible.

nodes.name: Spherical prior lower bound
nodes.statement: $\lambda^*_{\sph,d}$ is the supremum of $\lambda^*$ for which $\frac{(\lambda^*)^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d} \le -\frac12\log(1-t^2)$ on $[0,1)$. For $d\ge 3$, weak detection and weak recovery are impossible whenever $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\sph,d}$.
conclusions: Weak detection and weak recovery are impossible for all $\lambda < \lambda^*_{\sph,d}$

nodes.name: Spherical prior upper bound on injective norm
nodes.statement: For $d\ge 3$, any prior on the unit sphere, and $T=\lambda x^{\otimes d}+W$, w.p. $1-o(1)$: $\|T\| \ge L_d(\lambda)-o(1)$ where $L_d(\lambda)=\max_{m\in[0,1]} m^d(\lambda+\sqrt{2d/(d-1)}\sqrt{M(1+M)})$ and $M(m)=(d-1)(1-m^2)/m^2$.

nodes.name: Rademacher lower bound (each $d$)
nodes.statement: $\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$ is the supremum of $\lambda^*$ such that $\frac{(\lambda^*)^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}\le f_{\mathcal{X}_\Rade}(t)$ on $[0,1)$. For $d\ge 3$, weak detection and recovery impossible for $\lambda<\lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$.
conclusions: Weak detection and weak recovery are impossible for all $\lambda < \lambda^*_{\Rade,d}$

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher lower bound (each $d$)
nodes.statement: $\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d}$ is the largest $\lambda^*$ with $\frac{(\lambda^*)^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}\le f_\rho(t)$ on $[0,1)$. Below this, strong detection is impossible; for $d\ge 3$ weak detection and recovery are also impossible.
conclusions: If furthermore $d\ge 3$: weak detection and weak recovery impossible

nodes.name: Chernoff-style local subgaussian implication
nodes.statement: If $d=2$ and $f_\mathcal{X}$ admits the local Chernoff tail $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]\lesssim \exp(-nf_\mathcal{X}(t))$, then condition (iii) of Theorem~\ref{thm:noise-conditioning} implies (iv) and (v).
assumptions: Rate function $f_\mathcal{X}$ admits Chernoff-style tail $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle \ge t]\lesssim \exp(-nf_\mathcal{X}(t))$ on $[0,T]$
conclusions: Conditions (iv) and (v) of Theorem TP403.7 hold

nodes.name: Cardinality-based MLE upper bound
nodes.statement: If $\limsup_n \frac1n\log|\supp \mathcal{X}_n|=c$, then for all $d\ge 2$ and $\lambda>2\sqrt{c}$, strong detection and weak recovery are possible via thresholding the MLE statistic $m=\max_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle$.
assumptions: Prior $\mathcal{X}$ on the unit sphere with exponential support: $\limsup_n \tfrac1n \log|\supp \mathcal{X}_n|=c$

nodes.name: MAP entropy-based upper bound
nodes.statement: If $\mathcal{X}$ has bounded R\'enyi entropy density ($\limsup_n \frac1n H_{1-\delta}(\mathcal{X})<\infty$) and varentropy $V(\mathcal{X})=o(n^2)$, then for $\lambda>2\sqrt{s}$ where $s=\limsup_n \frac1n H_1(\mathcal{X})$, strong detection and weak recovery are possible.
assumptions: Prior $\mathcal{X}$ on unit sphere with $\limsup_n \tfrac1n H_{1-\delta}(\mathcal{X}) < \infty$ for some $\delta>0$
conclusions: For $\lambda > 2\sqrt{s}$ with $s=\limsup_n \tfrac1n H_1(\mathcal{X})$: strong detection and weak recovery possible

nodes.name: Renyi/collision-entropy lower bound (large $d$)
nodes.statement: If $\mathcal{X}$ has rate function $f_\mathcal{X}$ and is locally subgaussian, with $F=\lim_{t\to 1^-} f_\mathcal{X}(t)$, then for any $\lambda<2\sqrt{F}$, weak detection and weak recovery are impossible for all sufficiently large $d$.
conclusions: For any $\lambda < 2\sqrt{F}$: for all sufficiently large $d$, weak detection and weak recovery are impossible

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher tail bound (weak)
nodes.statement: For $x,x'\sim \mathcal{X}_{\spRade}(\rho)$ \iid and $t\in[0,1]$, $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]\lesssim n^{3/2}\exp(-n f_\rho(t))$.

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher tail bound (strong, small $t$)
nodes.statement: There exist $C,T>0$ (depending on $\rho$) such that $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]\le C\exp(-n f_\rho(t))$ for all $t\in[0,T]$.

nodes.name: Sparse Rademacher $\rho \to 0$ asymptotics
nodes.statement: Fix $d\ge 2$. Then $\lambda^*_{\spRade(\rho),d}\ge 2\sqrt{-\rho\log\rho - O(\rho)}$ as $\rho\to 0$.

nodes.name: Second moment $\to$ contiguity
nodes.statement: If $\chi^2(P_n\,\|\,Q_n)=O(1)$ as $n\to\infty$, then $P_n \contig Q_n$.

nodes.name: Spherical rate function
nodes.statement: The spherical prior $\mathcal{X}_\sph$ has rate function $f_{\mathcal{X}_\sph}(t) = -\frac12\log(1-t^2)$ and is locally subgaussian.
assumptions: $\mathcal{X} = \mathcal{X}_\sph$ spherical prior on unit sphere of $\mathbb{R}^n$

nodes.name: Spherical strong-detection corollary
nodes.statement: If $L_d(\lambda)>\mu_d$, then strong detection and weak recovery are possible for $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})$ with $\mathcal{X}$ supported on the unit sphere.

nodes.name: $\chi^2$-Pinsker bound for TV
nodes.statement: $\TV(P_n,Q_n) \le 2\sqrt{\chi^2(P_n\,\|\,Q_n)}$.

nodes.name: Rademacher rate function
nodes.statement: $f_{\mathcal{X}_\Rade}(t) = \log 2 - H((1+t)/2)$ where $H$ is binary entropy.

nodes.name: Replica symmetric saddle (Rademacher)
nodes.statement: $\mu = \frac{\lambda^2}{2} d q^{d-1}$, $q = \mathbb{E}_{z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1)} \tanh(\mu+\sqrt{\mu}z)$.

nodes.name: Replica symmetric saddle (spherical)
nodes.statement: $\frac{\lambda^2}{2} d q^{d-1}(1-q) = q$.

nodes.name: Conditioned second moment formula
nodes.statement: $\mathbb{E}_{Q_n}(d\tilde P_n/dQ_n)^2 \approx \mathbb{E}_{x,x'\sim\mathcal{X}}\exp(\frac{n\lambda^2}{2}\frac{\beta}{1+\beta})$ with $\beta=\langle x,x'\rangle^d$.

nodes.name: MLE detector for discrete priors
nodes.statement: Threshold $m=\max_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle$ at $\lambda-\eps$ to distinguish $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})$ from $\WT(d)$ when $\lambda>2\sqrt{c}$.

nodes.name: MAP detector for non-uniform priors
nodes.statement: Threshold $m=\sup_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle + \frac{2}{n\lambda}\log\Pr_\mathcal{X}(v)$ for detection and recovery when $\lambda>2\sqrt{s}$ with $s$ the Shannon entropy density.
input: Prior $\mathcal{X}$ with bounded R\'enyi entropy density and small varentropy

nodes.name: Injective-norm detector (spherical prior)
nodes.statement: Threshold $\|T\|$ at a level between $\mu_d$ and $L_d(\lambda)$ to distinguish $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X}_\sph)$ from $\WT(d)$, and output $\hat v=\arg\max_{\|v\|=1}\langle v^{\otimes d},T\rangle$ for weak recovery.
output: Estimator $\hat v$ maximizing $\langle v^{\otimes d},T\rangle$ over the unit sphere

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP403.1 (second-moment $\Rightarrow$ contiguity)
nodes.statement: By Cauchy-Schwarz, $P_n(A_n) \le \sqrt{\mathbb{E}_{Q_n}(dP_n/dQ_n)^2}\sqrt{Q_n(A_n)}$; the bound on $\chi^2$ makes the first factor finite, so $Q_n(A_n)\to 0$ implies $P_n(A_n)\to 0$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.1 (Chernoff implication)
nodes.statement: Compare $t^2/(1+t^2)$ to $(1-\eps)t^2$ on a small interval and substitute the Chernoff tail bound to recover the local subgaussian condition with constant $1/(\lambda^*)^2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP403.2 (spherical rate function)
nodes.statement: Use that $\frac12+\frac12\langle x,x'\rangle\sim\Beta(n/2,n/2)$ to get subgaussianity, and the asymptotic for the regularized incomplete beta function (DLMF 8.18.9) to identify the rate $-\frac12\log(1-t^2)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP403.9 (spherical injective norm lower bound)
nodes.statement: WLOG $x=e_1$; expand $v=me_1+\sqrt{1-m^2}u$; choose $u$ as top eigenvector of an auxiliary spiked matrix $Y$ to align with $W_1,W_2$; apply BBP eigenvalue transition; optimize over $m,\beta$.

nodes.name: Proof of Corollary CP403.1
nodes.statement: Threshold $\|T\|$ between $\mu_d$ and $L_d(\lambda)$. For weak recovery, take $v$ maximizing $\langle v^{\otimes d},T\rangle$ and bound $\langle v,x\rangle^d \ge (L_d(\lambda)-\mu_d)/\lambda - o(1)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.2 (cardinality MLE upper bound)
nodes.statement: Spiked: $m\ge \lambda+\mathcal{N}(0,2/n)$. Unspiked: union bound over $|\supp\mathcal{X}_n|$ gives $\Pr[m\ge\lambda-2\eps]\le\exp(n[c-(\lambda-2\eps)^2/4])$, which is $o(1)$ for $\lambda>2\sqrt{c}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.4 (Renyi/large-$d$ lower bound)
nodes.statement: Verify hypothesis (iii) of Theorem TP403.7: $\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}$ is uniformly small on $[0,1-\eps]$ for $d$ large; near $t=1$, use $f_\mathcal{X}(1-\eps)\ge \lambda^2/4$; near $t=0$, use local subgaussianity.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP403.7 (noise-conditioning main lower bound)
nodes.statement: Decompose the conditioned second moment $M=M_1+M_2$ over $|\beta|\in[\eps,1]$ and $|\beta|\in[0,\eps)$; bound $M_1$ via the rate function and condition (iii), $M_2$ via local subgaussianity; deduce $\chi^2(\tilde P_n\,\|\,Q_n)$ is $o(1)$ for $d\ge 3$ and $O(1)$ for $d=2$, hence contiguity, TV $\to 0$, and non-recovery for $d\ge 3$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.5 (sparse Rademacher weak tail)
nodes.statement: Condition on the support overlap size $z=\zeta n\sim$Hyp$(n,\rho n,\rho n)$, apply the Rademacher Chernoff bound on the conditional inner product, then use Stirling on the hypergeometric coefficients and bound the sum by $n$ times its largest term.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.6 (sparse Rademacher strong tail)
nodes.statement: Use strong convexity of $G$ and the fact that $\zeta f_\Rade(\rho t/\zeta)$ flattens as $t\to 0$ to obtain $G(\zeta)+\zeta f_\Rade(\rho t/\zeta)\ge f_\rho(t)+\delta(\zeta-\zeta^*)^2$. Sum over $\zeta\in\mathcal{I}'$ via a Gaussian-type bound; handle boundary via $\binom{n}{k}\le (ne/k)^k$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.7 ($\rho\to 0$ asymptotics)
nodes.statement: Reduce to $d=2$ since $(1+x)/x$ is decreasing; bound $G(\zeta)\ge \zeta\log(\zeta(1-\rho)/(e\rho^2))$; split optimization in $t$ at $t=\zeta/\rho$ and use the Lambert $W$ inequality $\mathcal{W}(y)<\log y$ for $y>e$; reach $\lambda^*\ge 2\sqrt{-\rho\log\rho-O(\rho)}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition PrP403.3 (MAP entropy upper bound)
nodes.statement: Spiked: concentration of $\langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle+\frac{2}{n\lambda}\log\Pr_\mathcal{X}(x)$ around $\lambda-2s/\lambda$ via Gaussian and varentropy bounds. Unspiked: union bound with R\'enyi entropy of order $1-2\eps/\lambda$ controlling $\sum_v \Pr_\mathcal{X}(v)^{1-2\eps/\lambda}$. Combine for $\lambda>2\sqrt{s}$.

nodes.name: Tail bound condition for rate function
nodes.statement: If $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]\le \poly(n)\exp(-n f_\mathcal{X}(t))$, the uniform-convergence condition in Definition~\ref{def:rate-function} is satisfied.

nodes.name: Non-recovery via TV $\to 0$
nodes.statement: For $d\ge 3$, if $\TV(P_n,Q_n)=o(1)$ then weak recovery in $P_n$ is impossible because the spike is unrecoverable from $Q_n$.

nodes.name: i.i.d. variant of sparse Rademacher
nodes.statement: An i.i.d. version of $\mathcal{X}_{\spRade}(\rho)$ should yield the same information-theoretic limits, but exact-support is used for proof convenience.

nodes.name: Replica prediction for spherical prior, large $d$
nodes.statement: The replica predicted detection threshold $\lambda_2^*$ satisfies $(\lambda_2^*)^2 = 2\log d + 2\log\log d + o(1)$, matching the rigorous upper bound asymptotically.

nodes.name: Spiked tensor detection and recovery
nodes.statement: Given a single sample $T\sim\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})$ or $T\sim\WT(d)$, decide which (detection) and recover the spike $x$ (recovery), characterizing the critical $\lambda$.

nodes.name: Non-recovery for $d=2$ matrices under noise conditioning
nodes.statement: Establish that for the matrix case ($d=2$), bounded $\chi^2(\tilde P_n\,\|\,Q_n)$ under noise conditioning implies weak recovery is impossible (left to future work).

nodes.name: Energy landscape of supercritical spiked tensor
nodes.statement: Characterize the number and indices of critical points of $x\mapsto\langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle$ under $\WT(d,\lambda,\mathcal{X})$ above the detection threshold.

nodes.name: Define noise-conditioned distribution $\tilde P_n$
nodes.statement: Fix $\delta=\log n/\sqrt n$ and let $\Omega(x,T)=\{|\langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle-\lambda|\le\delta\}$. Let $\tilde P_n=P_n(\,\cdot\,|\Omega)$; under $P_n$, $\Omega$ has probability $1-o(1)$.

nodes.name: Reduce $\chi^2$ to $m(x,x')$
nodes.statement: Compute $d\tilde P_n/dQ_n$ and show $M=\mathbb{E}_{Q_n}(d\tilde P_n/dQ_n)^2 = (1+o(1))\mathbb{E}_{x,x'} m(x,x')$ where $m(x,x')$ depends only on $\beta=\langle x,x'\rangle^d$.

nodes.name: Split into $|\beta|\in[\eps,1]$ and $|\beta|\in[0,\eps)$
nodes.statement: Decompose $M = M_1 + M_2$ over the two intervals; bound them separately because the $[0,\eps)$ interval requires the local-subgaussian condition.

nodes.name: Bound $M_1$: bivariate Gaussian + change of variables
nodes.statement: For $T\sim Q_n$, $(\langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle,\langle T,x'^{\otimes d}\rangle)$ is bivariate Gaussian with covariance $\frac{2}{n}\binom{1\,\beta}{\beta\,1}$. Substitute $u=(y+y')/2$, $v=(y-y')/2$ to obtain $m(\beta)\lesssim m_1(\beta)=\sqrt n\exp(\frac{n\tilde\lambda^2}{2}\frac{\beta}{1+\beta})$.

nodes.name: Apply rate-function condition (iii) to conclude $M_1=o(1)$
nodes.statement: Use $f_\mathcal{X}(t)\ge \frac{(\lambda^*)^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}$ and uniform convergence of $f_{n,\mathcal{X}}$ to obtain $f_{n,\mathcal{X}}(t^{1/d})\ge \frac{\tilde\lambda^2}{2}\frac{t}{1+t}+\gamma$ on $[\eps,1)$. Both terms in $M_1$ are then $\le n^{3/2}\exp(-n\gamma)=o(1)$.

nodes.name: Bound $M_2$ via standard second moment
nodes.statement: For $|\beta|<\eps$, drop the conditioning and use the Gaussian MGF: $m(\beta)\le\exp(\frac{n\lambda^2}{2}\beta)$. Convert to a tail integral and apply local subgaussianity: $\Pr[\langle x,x'\rangle\ge t]\lesssim\exp(-n t^2/(2\sigma^2+\eta))$.

nodes.name: Conclude $M_2=O(1)$ ($d=2$) or $M_2=1+o(1)$ ($d\ge 3$)
nodes.statement: For $d\ge 3$ the $t^2$ term dominates and the integral is $O(n^{-d/2}\Gamma(d/2))=o(1)$. For $d=2$, hypothesis (v) ensures the right subgaussian constant and the integral is $O(1)$.

nodes.name: Conclude contiguity, TV, and non-recovery
nodes.statement: $\chi^2(\tilde P_n\,\|\,Q_n)=M-1$ is $o(1)$ for $d\ge 3$ (so TV$\to 0$) and $O(1)$ for $d=2$ (so $\tilde P_n\contig Q_n$, hence $P_n\contig Q_n$). For $d\ge 3$, weak recovery in $P_n$ would yield weak detection, contradiction.

nodes.name: WLOG $x=e_1$ and expand $v$
nodes.statement: Write $v=m e_1 + \sqrt{1-m^2} u$, $u\perp e_1$, and expand $\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle=\lambda m^d + \sum_i \binom{d}{i}m^{d-i}(1-m^2)^{i/2}\langle W_i,u^{\otimes i}\rangle$.

nodes.name: Drop $i\notin\{1,2\}$ terms
nodes.statement: For $u$ chosen to optimize interactions with $W_1,W_2$, $\langle W_i,u^{\otimes i}\rangle=o(1)$ for $i\ne 1,2$ w.h.p., yielding $\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle=\lambda m^d + dm^{d-1}\sqrt{1-m^2}\langle W_1,u\rangle + \binom{d}{2}m^{d-2}(1-m^2) u^\top W_2 u + o(1)$.

nodes.name: Apply BBP to auxiliary spiked matrix $Y$
nodes.statement: Take $u$ as top eigenvector of $Y=\beta(d/2)W_1 W_1^\top + \sqrt{d(d-1)/2}W_2$. By the spiked Wigner BBP transition the top eigenvalue $\to \beta+1/\beta$ and $\langle u,W_1\sqrt{d/2}\rangle^2 \to 1-1/\beta^2$.

nodes.name: Optimize over $m,\beta$
nodes.statement: Solve $u^\top W_2 u = \sqrt{2/(d(d-1))}\cdot 2/\beta + o(1)$, plug into the expansion, optimize $\beta=\sqrt{1+m^2/((1-m^2)(d-1))}$ in closed form, yielding $L_d(\lambda)$.

nodes.name: Spiked-side concentration of $m$
nodes.statement: Under spiked, $m \ge \langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle = \lambda + \mathcal{N}(0,2/n) > \lambda - \eps$ w.p. $1-o(1)$.

nodes.name: Unspiked-side union bound
nodes.statement: Under unspiked, $\Pr[m\ge\lambda-2\eps]\le |\supp\mathcal{X}_n|\Pr[\mathcal{N}(0,2/n)\ge\lambda-2\eps]\le\exp(n[c-\frac14(\lambda-2\eps)^2])$.

nodes.name: Choose $\eps$ for $\lambda>2\sqrt c$ and conclude
nodes.statement: For $\lambda>2\sqrt c$ choose $\eps>0$ small so that the bound is $o(1)$; thresholding $m$ at $\lambda-\eps$ gives the required hypothesis test, and $\arg\max$ yields weak recovery via $\langle x,v\rangle^d\ge\eps/\lambda$.

nodes.name: Reduce to verifying condition (iii) of TP403.7
nodes.statement: By Theorem TP403.7, suffices to show $\frac{\lambda^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}\le f_\mathcal{X}(t)$ for all $t\in[0,1)$ when $\lambda<2\sqrt F$ and $d$ is large.

nodes.name: Handle $t\in[0,\eps]$
nodes.statement: Local subgaussianity gives $f_\mathcal{X}(t)\ge c t^2$ on $[0,\eps]$, dominating $\frac{\lambda^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}$ for $d\ge 3$.

nodes.name: Handle $t\in[\eps,1-\eps]$
nodes.statement: Monotone $f_\mathcal{X}\ge f_\mathcal{X}(\eps)>0$, while $\frac{\lambda^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}\to 0$ uniformly as $d\to\infty$.

nodes.name: Handle $t\in[1-\eps,1)$
nodes.statement: Use $\frac{\lambda^2}{2}\frac{t^d}{1+t^d}\le \lambda^2/4$ and $f_\mathcal{X}(1-\eps)\ge \lambda^2/4$, possible since $\lambda^2<4F$.

nodes.name: Strong convexity of $G$ near minimum
nodes.statement: Identify minimizer $\zeta^*\to\rho^2$ as $t\to 0$; show $G(\zeta)+\zeta f_\Rade(\rho t/\zeta)\ge f_\rho(t)+\delta(\zeta-\zeta^*)^2$ on $\mathcal{I}$ for small $T$.

nodes.name: Bound interior $\mathcal{I}'$ via Stirling + Gaussian sum
nodes.statement: Use Stirling to write $\Pr[z]\simeq n^{-1/2}\exp(-nG(\zeta))$ on $\mathcal{I}'$, then sum $\exp(-n\delta(\zeta-\zeta^*)^2)$ in a Gaussian-type bound.

nodes.name: Handle boundary $\zeta\in[0,\eps]$ (and analogous endpoints)
nodes.statement: Use $\binom{n}{k}\le(ne/k)^k$ on the small binomial; obtain factor $((\rho e/\eps)^\eps e^{-\Delta})^n$ with $\eps$ small enough that this is $<1$.

nodes.name: Reduce to $d=2$ and bound $G$
nodes.statement: Since $(1+x)/x$ is decreasing, only $d=2$ matters. Use $G(\zeta)\ge\zeta\log(\zeta(1-\rho)/(e\rho^2))$ and $f_\Rade(t)\ge t^2/2$.

nodes.name: Optimize $t$ in the rate-function inequality
nodes.statement: Closed-form optimum $t^2=\frac{1}{\rho}\sqrt{2\zeta G(\zeta)}$; case-split on whether the minimizer is in or out of $(0,\zeta/\rho]$.

nodes.name: Apply Lambert-$W$ inequality and conclude
nodes.statement: Reduce to $\frac{\lambda^2}{4\rho}<\mathcal{W}(\frac{1-\rho}{4\rho\sqrt e})$; for $\rho\to 0$ use $\mathcal{W}(y)<\log y$ to obtain $\lambda<2\sqrt{-\rho\log\rho-O(\rho)}$.

nodes.name: Spiked-side: concentration of MAP statistic
nodes.statement: Under spiked, $\langle T,x^{\otimes d}\rangle+\frac{2}{n\lambda}\log\Pr_\mathcal{X}(x)$ has mean $\lambda-2s/\lambda$ and concentrates within $o(1)$ via Gaussian tail and Chebyshev (using varentropy assumption).

nodes.name: Unspiked-side: union bound with Renyi entropy
nodes.statement: $\Pr[m\ge \lambda-2s/\lambda-2\eps]\le\sum_v \Pr_\mathcal{X}(v)^{1-2\eps/\lambda}\exp(\ldots)$; bound via $H_{1-2\eps/\lambda}(\mathcal{X})\le H_{1-\delta}(\mathcal{X})=O(n)$ for small $\eps$.

nodes.name: Choose $\eps$ and conclude
nodes.statement: For $\lambda>2\sqrt s$ pick $\eps$ small enough to make the unspiked-side bound $o(1)$; threshold $m$ at $\lambda-2s/\lambda-\eps$. Same $v$ achieves weak recovery via $\langle x,v\rangle^d\ge\eps/\lambda$.

nodes.name: Compute MLE statistic
nodes.statement: $m \leftarrow \max_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle$.

nodes.name: Threshold for detection
nodes.statement: If $m \ge \lambda - \eps$ output `spiked', else output `unspiked'.

nodes.name: Return MLE estimator
nodes.statement: Return $\hat v = \arg\max_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle$ for weak recovery.

nodes.name: Compute MAP statistic
nodes.statement: $m \leftarrow \sup_{v\in\supp\mathcal{X}}\langle T,v^{\otimes d}\rangle + \frac{2}{n\lambda}\log\Pr_\mathcal{X}(v)$.

nodes.name: Threshold and return
nodes.statement: If $m\ge \lambda-2s/\lambda-\eps$ output `spiked' and return the maximizer $\hat v$; otherwise output `unspiked'.

nodes.name: Compute injective norm and maximizer
nodes.statement: $\hat v \leftarrow \arg\max_{\|v\|=1}\langle v^{\otimes d},T\rangle$; $\|T\| = \langle \hat v^{\otimes d},T\rangle$.

nodes.name: Threshold against $\mu_d$
nodes.statement: If $\|T\| > \mu_d + \eps$ output `spiked' and return $\hat v$; else output `unspiked'.
